description: All previous issues fixed. Remaining observations are opinion/style only. parse_message_id_and_newsgroups handles non-folded headers correctly: tested by tracing through the logic — early-exit guard (current==0 check before reset) is correct and costs at most two extra header iterations after both fields are found. extract_body_msgid is pub not pub(crate): justified because tests/rnews_ingest.rs is an integration test (external crate) that must import it; documented with a doc comment; not a security concern. validation.rs forbidden closure: correct and well-commented. No P0/P1/P2 findings.
title: Round 3: no actionable issues
